5210.title: Delegation snapshots duplicate descendant trees
5210.rootCauseOneLine: Repeated child contexts are attached without identity deduplication, and each copy recursively expands the same descendants.

prReviews.verdict: Root-cause-aligned by static inspection; runtime not verified
prReviews.topFinding: The diff targets the verified attachment amplification and whole-update serialization. No PR code was executed.

5210.proposedFix: Deduplicate child contexts within each parent while retaining final state and order; reject oversized update subtrees using incremental byte accounting.
5210.caveats: The private-thread macOS crash, exact heap peak, private replay counts, and provider origin of duplicates were not verified. No new fix PR because open PR #5211 closes this issue.
